{"command":"cat > /work/rounding.py <<'PY'
import math


def round_half_up(x: float) -> int:
    """Round *x* to the nearest integer, with ties away from zero."""
    magnitude = math.floor(abs(x) + 0.5)
    return magnitude if x >= 0 else -magnitude
PY
cd /work && pytest -q; git diff -- rounding.py 2>/dev/null || true"}
